Notes

Dear Giles Hugo,

Here’s the notes from your call with Wayne Biggs 01304 200915 on 22 September 2026 at 09:27:

This call was a discussion between Giles Hugo and Wayne Biggs from Harbor Shipping regarding transportation services and potential collaboration. Wayne clarified that Harbor Shipping does not handle transportation directly but may connect Giles with a sister company. Giles expressed interest in obtaining quotes from other suppliers and requested Wayne to pass on his contact details.

Recap

  • Giles Hugo inquired if Harbor Shipping could handle transportation; Wayne Biggs clarified they do not have their own vehicles but may connect him with a sister company that can assist.
  • Wayne offered to pass Giles' contact details to the sister company for a quote, which Giles welcomed, having already contacted multiple suppliers for market pricing.
  • Wayne thanked Giles for his email and invited him to contact Harbor Shipping for customs or costly shipments, offering ongoing support.
  • The call concluded with mutual good wishes and a polite goodbye.

Tasks

  • Wayne Biggs will pass Giles Hugo's contact details to the sister company for a transportation quote.
  • Giles Hugo will review quotes from other suppliers and decide on the best option for his shipment.
